lines: Built with: vite.config.js, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^2.2.0, vite ^7.0.0.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.

1 package is imported by its root in src and offers no module below it in its exports map, so the root is the only specifier there is: @tanstack/vue-query (4,649 B in 8 modules). Which of its modules arrive is decided by the package and by tree shaking, not by the import.
5 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
